theses.thesis: T1: Indices asset-linked fees keep growing at mid-teens rates as ETF assets compound, so Indices remains the main earnings driver.
theses.signpost: Indices asset-linked fee growth of at least 10% reported in the FY2026 10-K (about February 2027). Interim test: ETF AUM rising, not falling, each quarter.

theses.thesis: T2: Shareholder payouts above free cash flow are not sustainable without disposal proceeds, so leverage keeps rising.
theses.signpost: FY2026 buybacks plus dividends at or below free cash flow, and total debt growth below 10%, in the FY2026 10-K (about February 2027).

theses.thesis: T3: The current valuation requires revenue growth to return to historical rates, which consensus does not yet forecast.
theses.signpost: FY2026 consensus EPS at or above $17.94 with more analysts raising than cutting estimates over the next 30 days, confirmed at the FY2026 results (about February 2027).

theses.thesis: T4: Regulatory and legal costs will not erode the 42% operating margin, so the margin story holds despite supervision in Ratings, Indices and Energy.
theses.signpost: Operating margin excluding disposal gains of at least 40% in the FY2026 10-K (about February 2027).
